longTitle.officialTitle: To amend title 18, United States Code, to provide for the protection of community centers with religious affiliation, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Protecting Religiously Affiliated Institutions Act of 2018”.

section.heading: PROTECTION OF COMMUNITY CENTERS WITH RELIGIOUS AFFILIATION.
section.chapeau: Section 247 of title 18, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.content: in subsection (a)(2), by inserting after “threat of force,” the following: “including by threat of force against religious real property,”;

subparagraph.content: in the matter preceding paragraph (1), by inserting “or (c)” after “subsection (a)”;
in paragraph (3), by striking “and” at the end;
by redesignating paragraph (4) as paragraph (5); and

by inserting after paragraph (3) the following:
“(4) if damage to or destruction of property results from the acts committed in violation of this section, which damage to or destruction of such property is in an amount that exceeds $5,000, a fine in accordance with this title, imprisonment for not more than 3 years, or both; and” ; and

paragraph.content: in subsection (f), by inserting before the period at the end the following: “, or real property owned or leased by a nonprofit, religiously affiliated organization”.
